title: N Software Timers on One Hardware Timer

parameters.name: arg
parameters.description: Opaque argument passed to the callback

constraints: Only one hardware expiry may be armed at a time (hw_timer_set overrides previous)
One-shot timers only (each fires at most once)
Support at least 16 concurrent pending software timers
Fire ALL due timers (expiry <= now) on dispatch, then re-arm for the next soonest
No dynamic allocation required; candidate chooses the internal data structure
